name: MBG serial bridge
description: Our container (ser2net) on any Linux host — a Raspberry Pi next to the bus, a server. Each USB serial adapter it sees is one bus on its own TCP port, kept across replug; the gateway reads its adapters and sets their serial parameters.
setup: Run the bridge on the host the adapters are plugged into — the gateway shows the exact command.
Open the data ports (7001…) and the control port (7000) to the gateway's IP only: data ports carry raw Modbus, which has no authentication.
The token protects the control port; the gateway keeps it.
